question.text: Which SEBI circular introduced templates of Private Placement Memorandum for different categories of AIFs with common disclosure requirements?

answer.text: SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DF6/CIR/P/2020/24 dated February 05, 2020

explanation.text: The Logic: Per footnote 131 on page 346, SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DF6/CIR/P/2020/24 dated February 05, 2020 introduced templates of Private Placement Memorandum for different categories of AIFs with common disclosure requirements. The Trap: The October 21, 2021 circular is associated with the merchant banker filing requirement (page 351), and the April 10, 2023 circular relates to distribution/placement fee matters (page 359). Neither introduced the PPM templates. Note: The keyed answer is grounded in the workbook citation on page 346. The exact August 1, 2012 notification-date attribution should be separately verified before being relied upon in commentary.
